n, b = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
val = [1 if x % 2 != 0 else -1 for x in arr]

sum_ = 0
cost = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    sum_ += val[i]
    if sum_ == 0:
        cost_diff = abs(arr[i+1] - arr[i])
        cost.append(cost_diff)

cost.sort()
tcost = 0
maxp = 0
for c in cost:
    if tcost + c <= b:
        tcost += c
        maxp += 1

print(maxp)
